notes: This pack tests the 01/2026 common Annex G state machine and the 02/2026 profile-specific clockClass criterion only.
The 08/2026 G.8275, G.8275.1 and G.8275.2 amendments are in force/prepublished; their changes are not represented as conformant by this base-edition pack.
The FTS frequency-layer availability criterion is for further study and is not scored.
PTP time error is not inferred from clockClass or AS/UAS.
Each complete synthetic PM collection period is 15 minutes (900 seconds); the cross-period case tests the 10-second sliding window across two consecutive PM periods.

semantics: N1S means every observed parentDS.grandmasterClockQuality.clockClass value during the entire one-second interval is numerically <= defaultDS.clockclassAvailabilityThreshold; smaller clockClass is better.
D1S means at least one clockClass value during the one-second interval is strictly worse than the configured Cth threshold.
The default clockclassAvailabilityThreshold is 6. The threshold is configurable and the input value is bound to the exact profile record.
The 10 consecutive N1S/D1S window is applied in measurement time; maintenance windows pause evaluation and do not count as measured seconds.
A transition is attributed to the onset of the qualifying run, even though it is confirmed after the tenth consecutive second.
The sliding window crosses PM collection period boundaries; counters are reconstructed by the original sample period after the run is resolved.
An empty clockClass observation list is an explicit local UNKNOWN extension. It is not silently treated as D1S or N1S.
AS and UAS are evaluated separately for each PTP profile and exact criterion; FTS and PTS are never pooled.

Every non-maintenance sample carries explicit clockclass_coverage; N1S/D1S is only derived from COMPLETE coverage spanning the entire one-second interval. PARTIAL and UNKNOWN coverage remain unobserved even if sampled values appear nominal.
Profile-specific SyncaaS clock roles are explicit: G.8275.1 applies to T-BC; G.8275.2 applies to T-BC-A and T-BC-P. Other clock roles are not comparable under this profile dataset.
